name: Kombucha
siboNotes: The fermentation process can reduce FODMAP content, but residual sugars and added fruit flavors may trigger SIBO symptoms. Plain varieties are generally better tolerated than fruit-flavored ones.
preparationTips: Choose plain or ginger varieties over fruit-flavored options
Start with smaller portions to assess tolerance
Drink with meals rather than on an empty stomach
Look for brands with lower residual sugar content
nutritionalHighlights: Lower sugar than most soft drinks
